integrity: New result is given with a direct proof and accompanying finite computational corroboration; the finite tests do not establish the continuum theorem. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real-valued distributional BV(0,1) and unweighted Lebesgue-orthogonal projection only
Exact basis is 1, cos(m pi x), cos(3m pi x) for integer m>=1
Complete equality cases for arbitrary multijump inputs, non-1:3 ratios, weighted and complex variation are unclassified
Unindexed equivalent results in older Fourier variation literature cannot be excluded
title: Sharp bounded-variation norm of sparse odd-harmonic Neumann cosine projections
